//: Watch the source, and nothing the running server writes.
nodemon's defaults watch the whole backend folder for js/mjs/cjs/json, and
backups/ and uploads/ live inside it. A database backup is a .json file
written into backups/ — so creating one restarted the dev server, and the
restore that runs immediately after the safety backup was killed partway
through: the collection it was on had been emptied but not yet refilled.
Retrying just moved the damage to the next collection.
Anything the server writes at runtime belongs on this list.
